properties.name: Bhagsunag Flash Flood
properties.history: July 12, 2021: Intense cloudburst caused a massive flash flood in Bhagsunag area of McLeod Ganj. Numerous luxury cars were swept away and properties damaged.
properties.remarks: Urban drainage system overwhelmed by sudden discharge.

properties.name: Beas River Flash Flood
properties.history: July 2023: Beas river reached record levels in Mandi town. Historic Panchvaktra temple partially submerged. Mandi-Kullu highway washed away in multiple stretches.
properties.remarks: Highest flood level recorded in decades.

properties.name: Parvati Valley Flash Flood
properties.history: July 2023: Sudden rise in Parvati river levels. Several campsites in Kasol and Manikaran swept away. Major disruption to tourism infrastructure.

properties.name: Samej Flash Flood
properties.history: August 1, 2024: Massive cloudburst at Samej Khud. Entire village hamlets wiped out. Over 30 people missing or dead. Hydel project infrastructure destroyed.

properties.name: Chandra River Surge
properties.history: Summer 2023: Unusual flash floods in Lahaul valley due to combined effects of heavy rain and rapid snow melt. Blocked Atal Tunnel access roads.

properties.name: Ravi River Flash Flood
properties.history: July 2023: Ravi river caused extensive damage to Chamba-Pathankot highway. Local bridges and hydro-power intakes damaged.

properties.name: Nagwain Overflow
properties.remarks: Minor localized flooding due to river backflow.

properties.name: Swan River Spill
properties.remarks: Seasonal overflow affecting low-lying agriculture fields.
